title: schefflera longifolia
intro: Schefflera longifolia, commonly known as the Himalayan umbrella tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
